dataset_status: All store records, coordinates, warehouse location, and operating values in this sample dataset are invented for demonstration; they are not operational or research-paper case-study data.
location_note: Synthetic coordinates clustered around Amritsar, India. Store names are placeholders and do not identify actual businesses.

distance_matrix_method.method: Haversine great-circle distance computed from latitude and longitude
distance_matrix_method.rounding: Rounded to 2 decimal places after calculation
distance_matrix_method.interpretation: Straight-line geodesic distance, not road-network distance; symmetric by construction with a zero diagonal.

maximum_route_duration_minutes_per_slot.source: Invented sample parameter; total route operating time assigned to a slot must not exceed this duration

priority_score.source: Invented team heuristic; the 70/30 weights are not specified by the research paper
